exact: activation of host autophagy by virus
broad: positive regulation by virus of host autophagy
narrow: induction by virus of host autophagy
related: autophagy of host cells involved in interaction with symbiont

definition: A process in which a symbiont initiates, promotes, or enhances the normal execution of autophagy in the host cell. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction. For example, some viruses are able to activate host autophagy as a cellular survival mechanism, hence delaying or inhibiting apoptosis.
label: Activation of host autophagy by virus
